tasks.title: Laravel model bug fix in this repo (project root), file app/Models/HumanResources/HRLeave.php: the model has NO relationship methods at all (the 'relationship' section at the bottom is empty except for commented-out stubs), but the codebase calls many relations on HRLeave instances everywhere - e.g. app/Services/HumanResources/LeaveApprovalService.php calls $leav->hasmanyleaveapprovalbackup()->get() (4 sites), app/Services/HumanResources/AttendanceService.php line 3975 calls $l->hasmanyleaveapprovalbackup()?->get(), app/Http/Controllers/HumanResources/Leave/HRLeaveController.php calls $l->hasmanyleaveapprovalbackup()->create(...) (20+ sites), app/Http/Controllers/API/ModelAjaxCRUDController.php calls $sal->hasmanyleaveapprovalbackup()->update(...), and the leave blades (show/index/edit/reject) call hasmanyleaveapprovalbackup, belongstostaff, belongstooptleavetype, belongstooptleavestatus, belongstomanyleaveannual/leavemc/leavematernity/leavereplacement, hasmanyleaveamend, hasmanyattendance, hasoneleaveapprovalbackup/supervisor/hod/dir/hr. The error reported is: Call to undefined method App Models HumanResources HRLeave::hasmanyleaveapprovalbackup() (i.e. the method is missing from the model). FIX: restore the FULL relationship set from the git history version - the original model at commit fe5f58c (run: git show fe5f58c:app/Models/HumanResources/HRLeave.php) contains exactly the 19 relationship methods this app uses. Add to the current working file, VERBATIM from that original (same method names, same related-model classes, same foreign keys 'leave_id', same pivot tables 'pivot_leave_annuals'/'pivot_leave_mc'/'pivot_leave_maternities'/'pivot_leave_replacements' with 'leave_id' and the related id columns, withTimestamps): hasmanyleaveamend (related class HRLeaveAmend), hasmanyleaveapprovalbackup (HRLeaveApprovalBackup), hasmanyleaveapprovalsupervisor (HRLeaveApprovalSupervisor), hasmanyleaveapprovalhod (HRLeaveApprovalHOD), hasmanyleaveapprovaldir (HRLeaveApprovalDirector), hasmanyleaveapprovalhr (HRLeaveApprovalHR), hasmanyattendance (HRAttendance, 'leave_id'), belongstomanyleaveannual, belongstomanyleavemc, belongstomanyleavematernity, belongstomanyleavereplacement, belongstostaff (the Staff model, 'staff_id'), belongstooptleavetype (OptLeaveType, 'leave_type_id'), belongstooptleavestatus (OptLeaveStatus, 'leave_status_id'), hasoneleaveapprovalbackup, hasoneleaveapprovalsupervisor, hasoneleaveapprovalhod, hasoneleaveapprovaldir, hasoneleaveapprovalhr. ALSO add the missing imports at the top of the file (the 'use Illuminate Database Eloquent Relations ...' lines are currently commented out): add 'use Illuminate Database Eloquent Relations HasOne;', 'use Illuminate Database Eloquent Relations HasMany;', 'use Illuminate Database Eloquent Relations BelongsTo;', 'use Illuminate Database Eloquent Relations BelongsToMany;' with the proper namespace backslashes (the normal PHP namespace separators) so the return types resolve. KEEP everything already in the working file unchanged: protected $table = 'hr_leaves'; (the recent fix - do NOT remove it), the $casts block, the $fillable block, use SoftDeletes, class extends the App Models Model base. Place the restored methods in the 'relationship' section at the bottom of the class. Do NOT touch any other file. Then verify: (1) php -l app/Models/HumanResources/HRLeave.php (no syntax errors); (2) method presence check - write a tiny temp PHP file at the project root named verify_hrleave_tmp.php that boots Laravel and prints the count of the 19 method names that exist via method_exists on a new HRLeave instance, then run php -f verify_hrleave_tmp.php and DELETE the temp file after; the count must be 19. Report the exact diff (what was added), the php -l result, and the method count.

Verify the HRLeave relations restore in this repo (project root) end to end: (1) run the full PHP test suite `php artisan test` - must stay green (baseline: 47 passed / 159 assertions, self-contained OutstationEditTest needs NO database). (2) Smoke-test the restored relations against the live database (MySQL 8.0 @ 127.0.0.1:3306, user root, password 123123, database ipmaerp): write a tiny temp PHP file at the project root named verify_hrleave_tmp.php that boots Laravel, forces the mysql connection to host 127.0.0.1 user root password 123123 database ipmaerp (DB::purge + config set, same pattern as a normal tinker bootstrap), then fetches the first HRLeave row (or null if the table is empty) and prints: whether a row was found, the count from hasmanyleaveapprovalbackup() on it, whether belongstostaff resolves, and whether belongstooptleavetype resolves; run php -f verify_hrleave_tmp.php and DELETE the temp file after. The script must NOT raise any undefined-method error and must NOT raise SQLSTATE[42S02]. Report both results with the test report contract.
